description: This file defines the StoreCacheManagerImpl class which manages caching for stores in the application, extending a base CacheManagerImpl. It implements the singleton pattern to provide a single instance and initializes a named cache.

classes.name: StoreCacheManagerImpl
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for managing cache related to store data, extends CacheManagerImpl, and initializes a specific cache named 'StoreRepository'.
